column10: All four Blekinge domsagor and Karlskrona rådhusrätt belonged to Hovrätten över Skåne och Blekinge from its creation in 1820 until the 1971 reform. The build already has that for the other four and only Östra och Medelstads flaps to Göta hovrätt in 1866-1904 and 1915-1930, which put about 23 of Blekinge's 40 parishes under the wrong court of appeal for some 80 years. Found by the third held-out sample after it was measured; the fault is confirmed by the dataset's own treatment of the neighbouring courts, independently of that sample.
